verdict.rationale: The repo documents installing all skills for Claude Code, Codex and Pi in one non-interactive command via the open `skills` CLI. It also ships harness-specific packaging: a Claude plugin marketplace, Cursor metadata in `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, and a portable Hermes/Agent Plugins `plugin.json`, with `yy skills install/update` keeping all three agent copies in sync. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step install instructions for Cursor and the other harnesses (only metadata files are evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-agent installs.
